literal_meaning: মাছি (fly) টি (diminutive) ও (even) গলে (slips through/passes) না (not)
figurative_meaning_en: An extremely secure place or an airtight arrangement
similar_in_english: Not a fly on the wall
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের পরিকল্পনা এমন নিশ্ছিদ্র যে মাছিটিও গলে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This fortress is so secure that not even a fly can slip through.
Their plan is airtight; not even a fly can get through.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of impenetrable barriers, common in everyday Bengali discourse about safety and vigilance.
